header: HOW SERIOUS IS THIS ERROR (22 Nov 2026). Three ranks: SERIOUS (something of the application is broken for people: the developer is told at once), MINOR (a real fault that does little harm, or a one-off: in the daily digest), NOISE (not the application's fault: a browser extension, a lost connection, a resize loop: kept, counted, never announced). First a fixed list of patterns decides what is certain (free, instant, the same every time). Only an error nobody has classified goes to the AI model, once per distinct error, at most 20 an hour, with the text masked (scrub.ts maskForModel: no names, numbers or e-mail, only code locations of the stack). If the model is not there or answers badly I leave the error UNRATED and show it in the digest, never dropped. Pure apart from the model call, which is passed in.
